hotels.vendor_name: Olea All Suite Hotel - Member of Design Hotels
hotels.title: Greek Island Glamour: Zakynthos Luxury Suites with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Cocktails
hotels.description: Perched on a Zakynthian hillside among ancient olive groves, Olea All Suite Hotel is a five-star, design-led property with panoramic views from every corner. Designed in a tropical-modernist style, the hotel wraps around a sprawling lake-like pool, with streams and waterways threading between suite clusters, hidden gardens and age-old olive trees. Eat well, sleep better and do very little in between. Flow serves elevated Mediterranean cuisine with hilltop views, Flame celebrates premium cuts with open fire cooking, while Omikron delivers exquisite dining under soaring double-height ceilings with sea views stretching to the horizon. Olea Royal Spa rounds it all out with a hammam, sauna, yoga pavilion and a menu of deep relaxation treatments.

hotels.title: Opulent Five-Star Greek Island Villa Oasis with Private Beach, Three Restaurants & Rejuvenating Spa
hotels.description: An oasis of coastal opulence set on a magical private stretch of beach in one of Zakynthos’ most beautiful secluded bays, Porto Zante Villas & Spa is a stunning sight to behold. Providing five-star elegance around every corner, this boutique luxury resort boasts an array of award-winning private villas, each with unique views of the picturesque Ionian Sea. With modern stylings and supremely comfortable interior and exterior living spaces, unwind in the lush private garden, on the sun deck or in the spacious lounge and dining areas. Dine on your choice of exquisite Greek or tantalizing Asian cuisine at the resort’s restaurant offerings, indulge in a much-needed, rejuvenating massage at the onsite spa and toast to a holiday like no other with a refreshing waterfront cocktail.
